verdict.rationale: Shortcut's REST v3 docs say machine-readable versions of the API are provided in Swagger and OpenAPI, which is the capability this story asks for. The probe found 404s only at guessed URLs (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known), so it does not show the spec is missing from its actual published location. Missing for 10: a documented download URL or file location for the spec, details on spec version and coverage, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a successful download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: We provide machine-readable versions of our API specified in Swagger and OpenAPI.
